headline: Diplomatic delegation brings 400kg of premium saffron to bilateral summit to trade for a single authentic Iranian refrigerator magnet
body:
The Prime Minister’s international delegation arrived in Tehran this morning carrying four heavy-duty industrial crates of Kashmir’s finest Grade-A saffron, specifically sourced to secure a rare, plastic-molded refrigerator magnet shaped like a traditional Persian rug. Diplomatic aides confirmed the swap was prioritized over discussions regarding regional stability, after an intern noted the Prime Minister’s office fridge looked 'unduly bare' compared to other world leaders' breakrooms.

'We spent three months vetting the local souvenir shops for the perfect tacky accessory,' said a senior protocol officer who wished to remain anonymous. 'The Iranian President was initially confused when our trade ministers presented a kilo of golden spice, but he eventually agreed to sign the bilateral magnet-transfer protocol, provided we promised to stop asking about his Wi-Fi password for the duration of the summit.'

The magnet, which features a slightly peeling sticker of a historical mosque and the words 'Greetings from Persepolis,' will be ceremoniously attached to the high-security refrigerator in the Cabinet Room this Friday. According to observers, the successful acquisition of the magnet has prompted the delegation to look into trading a strategic oil pipeline agreement for an authentic Iranian keychain with a blinking LED light.
caption: Priorities, people. When the world is watching, make sure your office appliances look like they've traveled the globe. #DiplomacyGoals #SaffronSwap #FridgeMagnetDiplomacy #TafriTimes (satire)
igHook: Would you trade a year's supply of saffron for a plastic magnet?

It avoids the 'AI slop' trap of over-explaining the punchline and maintains a consistent, deadpan tone that makes the bizarre premise feel like standard government activity.
